note: Fifth shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the jeweller's, with deep emerald velvet walls and a white-grey marble floor. LANDMARK: the giant round brass safe door, half open, in the back wall. The oak doorway on the far left shows the slate-brick metal shop with its hanging chains (way back); the doorway on the far right shows the cream-and-cobalt general store with its wall of jars (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zoom: the glass display counter (z1).
